title: Ask Maps, tatil planlama ve randevu bulma özellikleriyle güncellendi
summary: Google, Ask Maps'e yolculuk planları oluşturma, randevu ayarlama ve kaydedilen listeleri sorgulama imkanı tanıyan yapay zeka tabanlı yeni yetenekler ekledi.
body:
Google, tatil dönemindeki yoğunluğu hafifletmek amacıyla Ask Maps için kapsamlı güncellemeler yayınladığını duyurdu. Gemini destekli bu yeni **Ask Maps** özellikleri, kullanıcıların karmaşık seyahat programlarını kolayca oluşturmasına ve günlük işlerini daha verimli yönetmesine olanak tanıyor. Güncelleme, bugün itibarıyla Android ve iOS cihazlarda kullanıma sunuluyor.

## Kişiselleştirilmiş seyahat planları
Yeni özellikler sayesinde kullanıcılar, günlük gezilerden çok günlük yolculuklara kadar detaylı seyahat rotaları oluşturabiliyor. Ask Maps, planlanan duraklar için numaralandırılmış harita pinleri ve günlük bir program sunarak süreci görselleştiriyor. Hazırlanan bu taslaklar, Google Docs üzerinden dışa aktarılabiliyor veya doğrudan arkadaş ve aile üyeleriyle paylaşılabiliyor. Kullanıcılar, yolculuk sırasında trafik durumu, işletmelerin güncel çalışma saatleri ve mekan atmosferi gibi canlı verileri görüntüleyebilir; rotalarını anlık olarak güncelleyebilirler.

## Randevu ve rota yönetimi
Google'ın geliştirdiği yeni aracı yetenekler, kullanıcıların hayatını kolaylaştıran pratik çözümler de sunuyor. Ask Maps artık güzellik, evcil hayvan bakımı, oto veya ev onarımı gibi alanlarda kullanıcılar adına işletmeleri arayarak randevu alma işlemlerini gerçekleştirebiliyor. Ayrıca, "Know before you go" (gitmeden önce bil) özelliği; park imkanı, şarj istasyonları, hava durumu ve geçiş ücretleri gibi konularda gerçek zamanlı bilgiler sağlıyor. Kullanıcılar, kaydettikleri mekanlar arasından belirli kriterlere uyan yerleri de hızlıca sorgulayabiliyor.

Ask Maps, Avrupa'da Almanya, İspanya ve İngiltere dahil olmak üzere 30'dan fazla ülkede daha erişime açıldı ve toplamda 200'ü aşkın ülkede hizmet verir hale geldi. Seyahat planlama ve liste arama özellikleri küresel çapta kullanıma sunulurken, randevu alma ve rota ipuçları ilk aşamada yalnızca Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde aktif olacak.

**Neden önemli?** Google'ın harita uygulamasına entegre ettiği bu agentic (araç kullanan) yetenekler, yapay zekanın sadece bilgi sağlamakla kalmayıp, kullanıcı adına dış dünyadaki fiziksel işlemleri de gerçekleştirebildiği bir kullanıcı deneyimine geçişi simgeliyor.

source_texts.title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
source_texts.summary: Plan holiday road trips, get route tips, find local appointments, and search your saved lists with new Ask Maps features.
source_texts.text:
New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
The holidays are a busy time between shopping for gifts, planning travel, and celebrating with loved ones. To help you stay one step ahead this season, we’re launching new Ask Maps features that make it easy to create itineraries, find available appointments, and search your lists in a snap so you can enjoy stress-free festivities.
Get on-the-go help with your holiday road trips
Now you can build step-by-step trip itineraries and get helpful, real-time details about your route right when you pull up directions.
Use Ask Maps to plan a day trip for holiday shopping or something more complex — like a three-day road trip with stops for coastal hikes and oceanfront dining. You'll get a day-by-day schedule with insider tips and numbered map pins for each stop, making it easy to visualize the plan. Once you're happy with the itinerary, share it with friends and family, or export it to Google Docs on desktop.
When you’re about to head out, use Ask Maps to pull up your itinerary or look for the “itinerary” badge in your chat history. You’ll see real-time details like live traffic conditions, whether a place is open, and even what the vibe is at your next stop. You can also adjust your schedule on the fly. Just use Ask Maps to add a scenic viewpoint or lunch spot along the way. Then, tap to get directions to your next stop right from your itinerary.
Whether you're taking a multi-day road trip or running errands around town, Maps keeps you a step ahead. Pull up directions to see helpful “Know before you go” tips about your route, including where to park or charge your car, and real-time conditions like weather, potential delays, and tolls.
Check off your holiday prep and let Maps find appointments for you
Holiday prep comes with a long list of to-dos. Now, with new agentic capabilities, you can choose to have Ask Maps find beauty, pet care, auto and home repair appointments online and call local businesses for you. Just ask, “Find me a 4 p.m. nail appointment near me.” Ask Maps will show you open slots across nearby businesses so it’s easy to decide what to book.
Show your guests the best spots on your lists
If you have friends visiting and want to show them around, now you can use Ask Maps to find saved places on your lists in seconds. Just ask, “Which spots saved in my lists have availability for five people in the next 30 minutes?” Ask Maps looks across your lists and checks live availability so you can pick a place and go.
These updates start rolling out today on Android and iOS just in time for the holidays. As part of today’s news, Ask Maps starts expanding to 30 countries across Europe — including Spain, Germany, and the U.K. — bringing Ask Maps to more than 200 countries and territories globally.
Travel itineraries and list search are available everywhere Ask Maps is offered. "Know before you go" route tips and finding appointments are launching first in the U.S., with more regions coming soon.

source_texts.text:
Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days.
Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you
The AI-powered Ask Maps feature can suggest stops for your next trip, while providing real-time details about each location.
As an example, Google says you can use Ask Maps to plan a day trip for holiday shopping, or have it create a schedule for a three-day road trip with stops for coastal hikes and oceanfront dining. From there, Ask Maps will generate a day-by-day schedule with a list of stops, while also showing your route and numbered pins for each location on the map. You can share the itinerary with friends or family members, as well as export it to Google Docs on desktop.
You can ask Maps to show your trip schedule before you leave, or select the “itinerary” badge in your chat history. Along with directions, Google Maps will display real-time information about traffic, a location’s hours, and more. You can also view “know before you go” details about parking, car charging, weather conditions, potential delays, and tolls during your trip.
In addition to trip planning, you can now use Ask Maps to find specific beauty, pet care, auto, and home repair appointments, and have it call the locations for you. You can also use Ask Maps to find saved places on your list by asking something like, “Which spots on saved in my lists have availability for five people in the next 30 minutes?”
Google is expanding Ask Maps to over 30 countries in Europe, including Spain, Germany, and the UK. Trip-planning and saved list search is rolling out to the more than 200 countries where Ask Maps is available, while “know before you go” tips and appointment-finding are launching in the US to start.
